title: Jadeveon Clowney: Logan Hall gave me the No. 90 jersey without me asking for it

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jadeveon Clowney: Logan Hall gave me the No. 90 jersey without me asking for it
sources.description: Sometimes, when a high-profile player arrives on a team and wants a jersey number that's already taken, it leads to a contentious issue in the locker room, or a high-priced negotiation.
